title: Technically correct but misses the point
description: Accurate trivia that ignores the actual ask (tradeoffs + recommendation).
prompt: Compare carbon taxes vs cap-and-trade for a developing country with weak institutions, then recommend one policy with two concrete implementation constraints.
candidate_text: Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas. Many countries discuss climate policy at international conferences. Recycling and planting trees are also environmentally friendly activities that individuals can do at home.
